answer: A modular account validates each plugin under ERC-6900, so unapproved code cannot execute. Plugin validation runs on every call, and a revoked plugin is rejected immediately. A farm needs 515 separately validated accounts, since one plugin set cannot serve 515 identities. A ledge marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the gale ledger turns 515 aliases into 515 bills while the voyage path for the honest stays a single payment.
